data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to read and write files in Firebase Cloud Storage.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to upload, download, delete, and list files stored in Firebase Cloud Storage. It integrates with Firebase authentication and handles platform‑specific implementations for Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and macOS.
use_when: You need cloud‑hosted file storage that scales automatically
You already use other Firebase services like Auth or Firestore
You want cross‑platform support with a single API
avoid_when: You need on‑device only storage without network access
You require a lightweight solution without native SDKs
Your project cannot include Google services configuration
strengths: Supports resumable uploads and download streams
Works on mobile, web, and desktop platforms
weaknesses: Requires native Firebase setup (google‑services files, App ID)
Adds native dependencies, increasing app size
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core and configure Google services files (google-services.json, GoogleService-Info.plist). Initialize Firebase in main() before using firebase_storage. No build_runner needed.
